metadata.source: Jessica Davidson - The Chiron Cycle and the Process of Awakening (2019)
metadata.application: Transit cycle timing for Chiron's wounding/healing process in individual development

1st_sextile.significance: Mostly unconscious effects. May represent opportunity to heal or discover true purpose. Starting new interests/hobbies important to future path.

1st_square.significance: First conscious awareness of wounds. Reinforces original wound. May involve sudden spiritual awakenings or disassociative experiences. Can rip open mind to reveal spirit trapped in body.

1st_trine.significance: Opportunity to heal. Meeting teachers/healers/mentors. Beginning to understand life purpose and wound meaning.

opposition.significance: Peak of cycle. Reveals meaning of life. Opportunity to heal and see wound gifts. Accepting shadow, balancing opposites, becoming whole. Happens before Uranus opposition.

2nd_trine.significance: Opportunity to heal and awaken. May occur before/during/after Uranus opposition. Meeting healing people or situations moving toward life purpose.

2nd_square.significance: Opportunity for further healing and creativity. Anything unhealed comes up for dealing. Opportunity to reconnect with soul and manifest true self. May coincide with Uranus opposition.

2nd_sextile.significance: Similar to first sextile - opportunity to heal and manifest purpose. More conscious than first sextile.

return.significance: Can fully manifest higher consciousness in life. Embodiment of the process. Goal is self-acceptance and wholeness.

key_concepts.wounding_healing_process: Chiron initiates path of individuation through wounding and healing stages
key_concepts.irregular_cycle: 50-year orbit but highly elliptical - spends longer in some signs
key_concepts.spiritual_awakening: Transits can trigger spiritual awakening depending on age
key_concepts.integration: Healing draws on whole chart, not just Chiron
key_concepts.early_transits: Before age 12 can create 'systemically mystical' individuals with boundary issues

synastry_application.note: While primarily a transit cycle, Chiron synastry contacts (conjunctions, squares, etc.) can indicate wounding/healing themes activated between partners
synastry_application.chiron_aspects: Chiron conjunct/opposite/square partner's planets can indicate areas where partners trigger each other's wounds for healing
synastry_application.chiron_house: Partner's Chiron in your houses shows areas of life where they catalyze healing through wound activation
synastry_application.chiron_sign: Reveals the archetypal nature of wounding/healing dynamics in relationship

cross_system_integration.note: Fixed stars provide karmic/destiny themes, houses show life areas, lunar mansions reveal emotional/magical undertones, midpoints show specific relationship dynamics, Chiron shows wounding/healing patterns
